groups.rationale: A VM actor no longer re-drives a command whose failed outcome it has durably recorded; it re-observes once after an actor restart and runs any newer command at once. Chapter 04 replaces the per-second retry gap with this behaviour and its property tests; ADR-0176 gains evidence.
